title: the implicit Runge-Kutta solvers have order 2 with Lie group nodes
author: Claude-JG
description: The rotation of a stage was the composition of the start of the step with the increment h sum_j A_ij omega_j, the formula of the other coordinates; the rotation vector of the increment differs from it by terms of h^2, so LobattoIIIA4, LobattoIIIC4GGL and Radau3 converged with order 2 on the spatial slider crank of modelLibrary.py with NodeRigidBodyRotVecLG (4, 4, 3 with Euler parameters). Decided: the increment of stage i is Delta_i = h sum_j A_ij TExpSO3Inv(Delta_j) omega_j (Runge-Kutta-Munthe-Kaas, as the explicit solvers), by a fixed-point iteration within the stages; revision2026c step RG20.7.4.
releaseNotes: The implicit Runge-Kutta solvers compose the rotation of a stage of a Lie group node with the increment Delta_i = h sum_j A_ij TExpSO3Inv(Delta_j) omega_j (Runge-Kutta-Munthe-Kaas, by a fixed-point iteration) instead of h sum_j A_ij omega_j: LobattoIIIA4, LobattoIIIC4GGL and Radau3 have their orders 4, 4, 3 with NodeRigidBodyRotVecLG, as with Euler parameters; it was 2.
